subject: URGENT unauthorised transaction on my account
body: Hi, I just received an SMS that RM2,450 was transferred out of my savings account 1620 4455 8891 at 2.13am. I did not make this transfer and I was asleep. Please block my account immediately and call me at 012-345 6789. My IC is 850412-10-5523.

subject: Saya ditipu - scam panggilan
body: Assalamualaikum. Semalam saya terima panggilan daripada orang yang mengaku pegawai polis. Dia suruh saya pindahkan RM8,000 ke akaun lain untuk siasatan. Saya sudah buat pemindahan itu dan sekarang saya sedar ia penipuan. Tolong bantu saya dengan segera. No telefon saya 019-876 5432.

subject: Card charged in another country
body: There are three charges on my credit card 4111 1111 1111 1111 from a merchant in Brazil totalling RM1,912. I have never been to Brazil and the card is in my wallet. Please stop the card and reverse these.

subject: Phishing SMS pretending to be Bank Contoh
body: I received an SMS saying my Bank Contoh account will be suspended unless I click a link and log in. I did not click it. Sharing this so you can warn other customers. The sender number was 011-2233 4455.

subject: Clicked a link and entered my password
body: I think I made a mistake. I got an email about a tax refund, clicked the link and typed in my online banking username and password. Then I realised the website address looked strange. Nothing is missing yet but I am scared. What should I do right now?

subject: Someone opened an account using my IC
body: I received a welcome letter for a current account I never applied for. Someone must have used my identity card details, 910723-08-6144. I want this account closed and investigated before it is used for anything illegal.

subject: Lost wallet with both cards inside
body: My wallet was stolen at the LRT station about an hour ago. It had my debit card and credit card inside. Please block both cards now. I can be reached at 017-555 2211.

subject: OTP messages I did not request
body: Since this morning I have received six OTP messages from the bank for transactions I am not making. I have not shared the codes with anyone. Is someone trying to get into my account? Please check urgently.

subject: Akaun saya digodam
body: Saya tidak boleh log masuk ke perbankan internet sejak pagi tadi dan baki akaun saya berkurang RM3,200. Saya tidak pernah buat transaksi ini. Tolong bekukan akaun saya segera. No IC saya 880305-14-7781.

subject: Is this email really from you?
body: I got an email from security@bank-contoh-verify.com asking me to confirm my card number and CVV to avoid deactivation. It looks suspicious to me. Can you confirm whether it is genuine? I have not replied to it.

subject: My mother transferred money to a scammer
body: My 68 year old mother was contacted on WhatsApp by someone offering an investment scheme. She transferred RM15,000 from her account 5544 3322 1100 yesterday evening. We have made a police report. Can the transfer be recalled? Please respond quickly.

subject: Unknown device logged into my online banking
body: I got a notification that a new device logged into my online banking from Johor at 11pm. I live in Penang and it was not me. I have changed my password but please check whether anything was done on my account.

subject: Fake Bank Contoh page on Facebook
body: There is a Facebook page using your logo and offering personal loans with an upfront processing fee. I am quite sure it is fake. Sending you the name of the page so your team can report it: Bank Contoh Loan Fast Approval.

subject: Duplicate debit that I never authorised
body: A subscription company has been debiting RM89 from my account every month since June. I never signed up for anything and I do not recognise the company. Please stop these debits and tell me how to get the money back.

subject: Mule account worry
body: A friend asked me to let him use my bank account to receive payments for his online business and I agreed. Now I see large amounts coming in and going out and I am worried it is not legitimate. I want to stop this. What do I need to do?

subject: How do I protect myself from scams
body: Good afternoon. I keep reading about scams in the news. Could you tell me what security features I should turn on for my account and whether there is a way to limit online transfers? No rush, just want to be careful.

subject: Kad saya hilang dan ada transaksi
body: Kad debit saya hilang dua hari lepas dan hari ini saya nampak ada tiga transaksi di stesen minyak yang saya tidak buat. Tolong sekat kad saya sekarang. Nombor telefon saya +60 13-777 8899.

subject: Cheque I did not write was cleared
body: My statement shows cheque number 004512 for RM6,300 was cleared last week. That cheque leaf is still in my cheque book and unsigned. Someone has forged a cheque. I need this investigated today.

subject: Caller asked for my TAC number
body: A man called saying he was from Bank Contoh fraud department and asked me to read out the TAC number sent to my phone. I refused and hung up. Reporting the number he called from: 03-8888 1234. Is my account safe?

subject: Furious - money gone and nobody helps
body: RM4,000 has vanished from my account through transfers I never made and I have been passed around three departments. This is theft from my account and I want it frozen and investigated right now, not next week.

subject: Terrible service at your Shah Alam branch
body: I waited two hours yesterday at the Shah Alam branch only to be told the officer had gone for lunch. The staff at the counter was rude when I asked how much longer. This is unacceptable for a bank of your size.

subject: Third email with no reply
body: This is the third time I am writing about the same issue and I have still not received a single reply. I was promised a call back within 3 working days. It has been three weeks. If I do not hear from you I will escalate to Bank Negara.

subject: Aduan tentang layanan pegawai
body: Saya ingin membuat aduan tentang layanan pegawai di cawangan Kuantan. Beliau bercakap dengan nada yang kasar dan tidak mahu menerangkan borang kepada ibu saya yang sudah tua. Saya sangat kecewa.

subject: Your app keeps crashing
body: The mobile app has crashed every time I try to pay a bill since the last update. I have reinstalled it twice. I pay for this service and it is frustrating that basic features do not work. Please fix it.

subject: Charged a fee nobody told me about
body: I was charged RM10 for a counter transaction and nobody informed me about this fee beforehand. I find it ridiculous to be charged for depositing my own money. I want an explanation and I expect better communication.

subject: Complaint: call centre hung up on me
body: I called your hotline at 03-2222 3344 this morning, waited 40 minutes, and the agent disconnected the call as soon as I explained my problem. I called again and the same thing happened. This is appalling service.

subject: Disappointed with how my case was handled
body: My dispute case was closed without anyone contacting me or explaining the decision. I only found out when I called to ask. I am disappointed with the lack of transparency and would like the case reviewed by a manager.

subject: ATM out of service for two weeks
body: The only ATM in our housing area in Taman Sri Muda has been out of service for two weeks. Elderly residents have to travel far to withdraw cash. Several of us have reported this and nothing has been done.

subject: Formal complaint and notice of legal action
body: Despite repeated complaints, your bank has failed to correct an error that has damaged my credit record. I have instructed my lawyer and will take legal action if this is not resolved within 7 days. Consider this formal notice.

subject: Tidak puas hati dengan perkhidmatan
body: Saya sudah tiga kali datang ke cawangan untuk urusan yang sama dan setiap kali diberitahu dokumen tidak lengkap, tetapi senarai dokumen yang diberi berbeza setiap kali. Saya tidak puas hati dan membuang masa saya.

subject: Wrong information given by your staff
body: Your officer told me my fixed deposit could be withdrawn early without penalty. When I did it, I lost all the profit. I made a decision based on wrong information from your staff and I want this complaint recorded.

subject: Marketing calls will not stop
body: I have asked four times to be removed from your telemarketing list and I am still getting calls about insurance on my number 016-222 3344 almost daily. This is harassment. Stop the calls.

subject: Long queue, only one counter open
body: On the last working day of the month you had one counter open for about sixty customers. I took half a day of leave to do a five minute transaction. Please plan your staffing better. Very poor service.

subject: Complaint about discrimination at branch
body: The security guard at your Ipoh branch refused to let my father in because he was wearing slippers, while other customers dressed the same way walked in. He felt humiliated. I want a formal apology and an explanation.

subject: Still waiting for refund - escalating to BNM
body: You confirmed in writing a month ago that the double charge would be refunded within 14 days. Nothing has arrived. I am escalating this to BNM today unless I get confirmation of the refund date.

subject: Your chatbot is useless
body: I spent 20 minutes with your chatbot and it kept sending me the same FAQ link. There was no option to speak to a person. Frustrated customers should not have to fight a robot to get help.

subject: Unhappy with branch closure
body: I am very unhappy that you are closing the Kampar branch. It is the only branch within 30km and many pensioners depend on it. Nobody consulted the community. Please reconsider.

subject: Privacy complaint - statement sent to wrong address
body: My account statement was posted to my previous address even though I updated my details in March and received your confirmation. A stranger now has my financial information. I am lodging a formal complaint about this breach.

subject: Poor handling of my late father's account
body: It has been five months since I submitted all documents to release my late father's account and each time I call, a different officer asks for the same documents again. This has been a painful experience for my family.

subject: Worst banking experience
body: I have been a customer for 12 years and this has been the worst experience. Nobody takes ownership, emails go unanswered and the branch tells me to call the hotline while the hotline tells me to visit the branch.

subject: Request for 6 months bank statement
body: Hello, I need my savings account statements for the last six months for a visa application. Account number 1122 3344 5566. Can you email them to me or tell me how to download them?

subject: Update my mailing address
body: I have moved house and would like to update my mailing address. Please let me know what documents you need. My IC number is 930815-05-4432.

subject: Cannot log in to online banking
body: I forgot my online banking password and after three tries my access is now locked. I need to pay my rent today. How can I reset it quickly?

subject: Cara buka akaun simpanan
body: Salam, saya ingin tahu apakah dokumen yang diperlukan untuk membuka akaun simpanan untuk anak saya yang berumur 10 tahun. Adakah baki minimum diperlukan? Terima kasih.

subject: Increase daily transfer limit
body: I need to transfer RM60,000 for a property down payment this Friday but my daily online transfer limit is RM30,000. How do I increase the limit temporarily?

subject: Salary not showing in my account
body: My employer says my salary was credited on the 25th but I cannot see it in my account 7788 9900 1122. I have bills due tomorrow. Can you check where the money is?

subject: Close my current account
body: I would like to close my current account as I no longer use it. Please advise on the procedure and whether I need to come to the branch in person.

subject: Dormant account reactivation
body: I have not used my savings account since 2021 and I was told it is now dormant. What do I need to do to reactivate it? There should still be some balance in it.

subject: DuitNow transfer went to wrong number
body: I made a DuitNow transfer of RM500 this morning but keyed in the wrong mobile number by one digit. Is there a way to get it back? The reference number is 20261117884512.

subject: Fixed deposit maturity question
body: My 12-month fixed deposit matures next month. Will it renew automatically, and can I change the instruction so the profit is credited to my savings account instead?

subject: Tukar nombor telefon berdaftar
body: Saya telah menukar nombor telefon bimbit. Bagaimana saya boleh kemaskini nombor baru 014-668 2291 supaya saya boleh terima TAC? Nombor lama sudah tidak aktif.

subject: Open a joint account
body: My wife and I want to open a joint savings account. Do we both need to be present at the branch and can either of us operate the account alone?

subject: Account frozen without notice
body: I tried to withdraw cash and was told my account is frozen. Nobody informed me and I have no idea why. I cannot access any of my money. Please tell me what is going on and how to resolve it.

subject: Name correction on account
body: My name is spelled wrongly on my account and cheque book, one letter is missing. How do I get this corrected? I can provide my IC 870220-01-5567 as proof.

subject: Interbank transfer not received after 2 days
body: I transferred RM1,200 to another bank two days ago. The money has left my account but the recipient says it has not arrived. Can you trace it?

subject: Add nominee to my account
body: I would like to add my daughter as the nominee for my savings account. What is the process and is there any form I can fill in beforehand?

subject: Statement for business account
body: We need the December statement for our company current account for our auditors. Please send it to our accounts team at finance@syarikatcontoh.com.my.

subject: Foreign currency transfer rates
body: I need to send money to my son studying in the UK every month. What are the charges and exchange rate for a telegraphic transfer, and can I do it through online banking?

subject: Minimum balance for savings
body: Quick question, just wondering what the minimum balance is for your basic savings account and whether there is a fee if it falls below that.

subject: Standing instruction set up
body: How do I set up a monthly standing instruction from my savings account to pay my daughter's school fees? I would like it to start next month.

subject: Request to waive annual fee
body: I have been charged the RM250 annual fee on my credit card. I have held this card for five years and always pay on time. Could the fee be waived this year?

subject: Credit limit increase
body: I would like to request a credit limit increase on my card ending 0004 from RM8,000 to RM15,000. My salary has increased and I can provide my latest payslips.

subject: Replacement card for damaged chip
body: The chip on my debit card is damaged and it no longer works at payment terminals or ATMs. Please send me a replacement. How long will it take?

subject: Aktifkan kad kredit baru
body: Saya baru terima kad kredit baru melalui pos. Bagaimana cara untuk mengaktifkan kad ini dan menetapkan PIN? Terima kasih.

subject: ATM swallowed my card
body: The ATM at Mid Valley swallowed my debit card just now and I am travelling outstation tomorrow morning. I need access to cash. How can I get my card back or get a new one today?

subject: Redeem reward points
body: I have about 42,000 reward points on my credit card. How do I redeem them and do the points expire?

subject: Card declined overseas
body: I am in Japan right now and my credit card is being declined everywhere. I informed the bank about my travel before I left. I have no other card with me. Please enable it urgently.

subject: Cashback not credited
body: Your promotion promised 5% cashback on groceries in October. I spent RM900 on groceries but did not receive any cashback in my statement. Can you check?

subject: Convert purchase to instalment plan
body: I bought a laptop for RM4,500 with my credit card last week. Can I convert this purchase into a 12-month instalment plan, and what are the charges?

subject: Change card PIN
body: I would like to change the PIN for my debit card. Can I do this through the app or must I go to an ATM?

subject: Supplementary card for spouse
body: I want to apply for a supplementary credit card for my husband. What documents are needed and is there an additional annual fee?

subject: Card expiring next month, no new card yet
body: My credit card expires at the end of next month and I have not received the renewal card. Has it been sent? My address has not changed.

subject: Batalkan kad kredit
body: Saya ingin membatalkan kad kredit saya kerana jarang menggunakannya. Sila maklumkan baki tertunggak dan prosedur pembatalan.

subject: Turn on overseas and online usage
body: How do I enable overseas transactions and online purchases on my debit card? I am going to Thailand next week.

subject: Late payment charge on card
body: I paid my credit card bill one day late because of the public holiday and was charged a late fee. Would it be possible to reverse it as a one-time courtesy?

subject: Contactless limit
body: Can I lower the contactless payment limit on my debit card? I would prefer to enter my PIN for anything above RM100.

subject: Balance transfer offer
body: I saw your balance transfer promotion. I would like to transfer RM6,000 from another bank's credit card. What is the rate and tenure offered?

subject: Upgrade to platinum card
body: I currently hold the classic credit card. Am I eligible to upgrade to the platinum card and what is the minimum income requirement?

subject: Card blocked after wrong PIN
body: I entered the wrong PIN three times at the ATM and now my debit card is blocked. I need to withdraw money for my child's clinic visit today. How do I unblock it?

subject: Card statement e-delivery
body: Please switch my credit card statement from paper to e-statement. Send it to my registered email going forward.

subject: Early settlement of personal financing
body: I would like to settle my personal financing early. Could you give me the settlement amount as of the end of this month and tell me if there is any rebate?

subject: Home financing application status
body: I submitted my home financing application three weeks ago and my sale and purchase agreement has a deadline next week. Can you update me on the status? The developer is pressing me.

subject: Mohon penjadualan semula pembiayaan
body: Saya telah diberhentikan kerja bulan lepas dan tidak mampu membayar ansuran pembiayaan peribadi buat masa ini. Bolehkah saya memohon penjadualan semula atau penangguhan bayaran?

subject: Car loan interest rate
body: I am planning to buy a new car around RM90,000. What is your current hire purchase rate for a 7 year tenure and how much would the monthly instalment be?

subject: Missed instalment this month
body: I missed my home financing instalment this month due to a medical emergency. I will be able to pay in two weeks. Will there be a penalty and will this affect my credit report?

subject: ASB financing enquiry
body: I am interested in ASB financing of RM100,000. What is the profit rate and the maximum tenure? Do I need a guarantor?

subject: Loan statement for tax filing
body: Please send me the annual statement for my housing loan showing the interest paid in 2025. I need it for my income tax filing.

subject: Letter of demand received
body: I received a letter of demand for arrears on my car financing. I paid the outstanding amount last week at the branch and have the receipt. Please confirm my account is up to date before any repossession action.

subject: Refinance my house
body: I would like to refinance my existing home loan with another bank to yours. The outstanding balance is around RM320,000. What rates do you offer and what are the legal costs?

subject: Tambah tempoh pembiayaan
body: Bolehkah saya memanjangkan tempoh pembiayaan perumahan saya daripada 20 tahun kepada 30 tahun untuk mengurangkan ansuran bulanan? Apakah syarat-syaratnya?

subject: Personal loan eligibility
body: I earn RM4,200 a month and work in the private sector. How much personal financing would I be eligible for and what documents do I need to apply?

subject: Release of car ownership after full settlement
body: I fully settled my car loan in September but the bank's claim on the vehicle ownership has not been removed at JPJ. I am trying to sell the car this week. Please expedite.

subject: Change instalment deduction date
body: My salary date has changed to the 28th. Can my personal financing instalment deduction be moved from the 15th to the 30th of each month?

subject: SME business financing
body: I run a small bakery and want to apply for business financing of RM50,000 to buy equipment. What schemes do you have for small businesses?

subject: Redraw from flexi home loan
body: I have made extra payments into my flexi home loan. How do I withdraw the excess amount and how long does it take?

subject: Tunggakan pembiayaan kereta
body: Saya ada tunggakan dua bulan untuk pembiayaan kereta. Saya ingin berbincang cara pembayaran supaya kereta saya tidak ditarik. Tolong hubungi saya segera di 018-234 5566.

subject: Education loan for my daughter
body: Do you offer education financing for a degree at a private university? My daughter starts in February and the fees are about RM28,000 a year.

subject: Financing offer letter correction
body: The offer letter for my home financing states the wrong property address. The unit number should be B-12-07, not B-12-01. Please issue a corrected letter before I sign on Thursday.

subject: Partial prepayment
body: I received a bonus and want to pay RM20,000 towards my home loan principal. Will this reduce my monthly instalment or shorten the tenure?

subject: Guarantor wants to withdraw
body: I am the guarantor for my brother's personal loan taken in 2023. I would like to know if I can be released as guarantor and what the procedure is.

subject: Boost your website ranking today
body: Dear business owner, we offer guaranteed first page Google ranking with our SEO packages starting from USD99 a month. Reply to this email for a free website audit.

subject: Thank you to your staff, Puan Aishah
body: I just wanted to say thank you to Puan Aishah at your Bangi branch. She was patient and helped my elderly father with his forms. Great service, please pass on our appreciation.

subject: Internship application
body: I am a final year computer science student and would like to apply for an internship at Bank Contoh from March to August. My resume is attached. Who should I contact?

subject: Congratulations you have won
body: Congratulations! Your email address has won 850,000 pounds in the international lottery draw. To claim your prize send your full name and bank details to our agent.

subject: Sponsorship request for school sports day
body: Our school is organising its annual sports day in February. We would like to ask whether Bank Contoh could sponsor medals and refreshments. A proposal is attached.

subject: Unsubscribe
body: Please remove this email address from your newsletter mailing list. I am no longer a customer.

subject: Branch opening hours during Raya
body: What are the opening hours of your Kota Bharu branch during the Hari Raya week?

subject: Suggestion for your mobile app
body: A suggestion: it would be useful if the app allowed us to set savings goals and see spending by category. Other than that the app is good. Keep it up.

subject: Partnership proposal - payment terminals
body: We are a fintech company providing payment terminals to merchants. We would like to explore a partnership with Bank Contoh. Could you direct us to your business development team?

subject: Invoice attached for your review
body: Please find attached invoice INV-20931 for services rendered in October. Kindly process payment within 30 days.

subject: Jawatan kosong
body: Salam, adakah terdapat jawatan kosong untuk pegawai khidmat pelanggan di cawangan Melaka? Saya mempunyai tiga tahun pengalaman dalam bidang perbankan.

subject: Invitation to speak at fintech webinar
body: We are hosting a webinar on digital banking trends next month and would like to invite a speaker from Bank Contoh. Please let us know who we can speak to.

subject: Terima kasih
body: Terima kasih kepada pasukan Bank Contoh kerana menyelesaikan masalah saya dengan cepat minggu lepas. Perkhidmatan yang sangat baik.

subject: Student research survey
body: I am a university student doing research on customer satisfaction in Islamic banking. Would your bank be willing to take part in a short survey? It takes about ten minutes.

subject: Cheap office supplies wholesale
body: Promotion this month only: A4 paper, toner and stationery at wholesale prices with free delivery in Klang Valley. Contact our sales team for a quotation.

subject: Media enquiry
body: I am a journalist writing about digital banking adoption among small businesses. Could I arrange an interview with someone from your corporate communications team this month?

subject: Out of office
body: Thank you for your email. I am out of the office until Monday with limited access to email. For urgent matters please contact my colleague.

subject: Wrong recipient?
body: Hi Daniel, are we still on for futsal on Saturday night? Let me know so I can book the court.

subject: Vendor registration
body: We supply air conditioning maintenance services and would like to register as a vendor with Bank Contoh. Where can we get the vendor registration form?

subject: Nice new branch
body: Visited your new branch in Setia Alam today. Bright, comfortable and the queue system was fast. Good job to the team.
